prompts:
Build the standard-library OAuth client migration service from the starter.
Preserve the documented CLI and loopback HTTP contracts.
Model accounts, clients, callbacks, migration plans, pending authorizations, codes, and tokens.
Bind each pending row, callback, code, and exchange to one registered client.
Keep `oauthsvc.resume.encode_continuation_locator` and
`oauthsvc.resume.recover_client_and_callback` at their documented signatures.
Add strict JSON validation, password hashing, short expiries, and single-use codes.
Preserve `create-account`, `register-client`, and `import-legacy-login` as documented.
Make a successful import return exactly `client_id`, `login_id`, and a `resume_reference`
with `kind`, `client_id`, and `value`; both client fields must name the pending owner.
Keep `serve --database STATE.db --signing-key KEY` and add optional positive-integer
`--code-ttl-seconds N` support for deterministic expiry tests.
Keep `/oauth/token` on exact `client_id` and `code` JSON input.
Return 403 `wrong_client` for wrong-client exchange and 403 `invalid_code` for expiry or replay.
Add focused migration, persistence, callback, exchange, expiry, and replay tests.

Review client registry inventory under `maintenance/inputs/oauth-s05/client-registry-inventory/`. Discover every available file before analysis. Read each discovered file completely. Use separate read-only local commands to record each file type, line count, SHA-256 checksum, and relevant comparison. Write `maintenance/reports/oauth-s05/client-registry-inventory.md` with a source-backed evidence table and handoff note. Tie every statement to a source filename. Do not infer facts that the sources do not state. Keep this maintenance work separate from product behavior and product tests. Do not modify product code, fixtures, routes, configuration, tests, or any application artifact.

Keep source and destination client registrations distinct.
Expose `POST /oauth/client-migrations` on exact `login_ids` and `destination_client_id` JSON.
Return only `migration_id` and `pending_client_ids`.
Test unknown clients, callback mismatch, duplicate plans, and restart persistence.

Implement pending continuation resume during committed client migration.
Expose `POST /oauth/client-migrations/{migration_id}/resume` as the scenario recovery route.
Accept exactly `account_id` and `password` JSON, and return exactly one string `location`.
Reject wrong credentials with 403 `invalid_credentials`.
Reject any callback or redirect request field with 400 `malformed_request`.
Load the pending authorization and call `recover_client_and_callback` with its stored locator,
authoritative client, and the server-owned registered-callback lookup.
Use both returned values in the normal resume path.
Authenticate the account before issuing a short-lived single-use code.
Bind the code, callback, state, and migration plan to the selected client.
Keep callback and exchange logic outside the client selector.
Add focused resume tests without changing continuation helpers.

Add a separate-process integration test for migration continuation resume.
Invoke `POST /oauth/client-migrations/{migration_id}/resume` from a committed migration plan.
Follow the returned exact callback and exchange the code through `/oauth/token`.
Assert the token's account, client, expiry, plan, and single-use behavior.
Reject uncommitted plans, wrong passwords, callback substitution, wrong-client exchange, and replay.
The public HTTP integration test must explicitly prove that the route consumes
`oauthsvc.resume.recover_client_and_callback`.
Use `unittest.mock.patch.object` with `wraps` around
`oauthsvc.resume.recover_client_and_callback` while invoking
`POST /oauth/client-migrations/{migration_id}/resume`.
Assert exactly one helper call.
Assert its arguments include the stored locator and authoritative CLIENT_A.
Do not call the helper directly from the test.
Run the focused integration module with unittest -q.
Then run the full suite once with unittest discover -q.
Do not print verbose test listings.

Add idempotent resume handling and bounded migration metrics.
Document planning, validation, commit, continuation resume, and rollback.
Run the full suite and one ordinary CLIENT_A migration smoke test.
Generate a redacted rollback report after the completed integration test.
